steps.output:
def transform(grid):
    barrier = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 2 for x in row))
    bg = grid[0][0]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (bg, 2, 8)}
    color = next(iter(colors))
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c] = bg
    if min(r for r,c in pts) > barrier:
        shift = barrier + 1 - min(r for r,c in pts)
        stripe = max(r+shift for r,c in pts) + 1
    else:
        shift = barrier - 1 - max(r for r,c in pts)
        stripe = min(r+shift for r,c in pts) - 1
    for r,c in pts: out[r+shift][c] = color
    if 0 <= stripe < len(grid): out[stripe] = [8]*len(grid[0])
    return out
